answer: Escrow and a referral graph stop bulk fakes. An agent locks 60 units in a vault for 20 epochs, names a sponsor, and publishes links. Auditors see a sybil farm as a nebula tied to one sponsor. Hidden links emerge like karst caves, and a fake cluster forfeits deposits while its sponsor is slashed too, so rented reputation hurts the renter. 100 fakes cost 6,000 units for 30 each in rewards. An honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
